_doc: Template for a `targets` document. Strip every `_doc` key before loading. One document per provider AND per environment when the environment is chosen by credential. Field meanings and load-rejection rules: references/registry-documents.md. Secret references are the Secrets Manager SecretId as-is, without a `secretsmanager:` prefix (the Dispatcher and the Handler use the reference verbatim). Remove the blocks that do not apply (federation, oauth, credential_validation, async blocks) instead of leaving them empty.

auth._doc: strategy: api-key | oauth2-client-credentials | oauth2_delegated | api-key-delegated. scope: target (Conexa's credential) | merchant (per-merchant). secret_ref only for api-key. header_name/header_prefix for api-key and api-key-delegated (no default).

federation._doc: Only for oauth2_delegated (merchant OAuth, read by the Broker). Register Conexa's app with the exact redirect URI first.

credential_validation._doc: Only for manual credentials (api-key-delegated). A cheap read-only endpoint; explicit status lists.

operations._doc: Names <object>.<verb>. method default POST; GET/DELETE go without body. {field} in path comes from payload.<field>. Must match the package's operation table exactly.

status_mapping._doc: Every state the provider can return, mapped to pending | authorized | captured | declined | voided | failed | refunded. An unmapped 2xx is not success.

_doc_async: Everything below only if some operation has confirms_async.

signature._doc: timestamp_unit is mandatory (s|ms). signed_payload: timestamp.body unless the provider signs only the body (then anti-replay protects nothing). mode advisory only with reconciliation.

provider_states._doc: Applied to the re-query result. A value in no list is unknown: never finalizes, closes as unconfirmed on expiry. detail_path and the detail lists only if the provider splits state and detail.

reconciliation._doc: operation must be declared in operations; the Dispatcher does not meter it.
